bookingEligible: only reegan-gandhi and candidate-01 (owner instruction, 2026-10-20). Must match ELIGIBLE_TEACHERS in access/worker/src/consultations.js. Eligible is not bookable, and a listed teacher is never bookable: see docs/live-classes-consultation-booking.md.
